Named after NBC’s iconic logo, Peacock is a video streaming service that primarily features series and film content from NBCUniversal studios, as well as news and sports programming. Premium tiers include a larger content library and access to additional NBC Sports, Hallmark Channel, and WWE content—yes, we’re talkin’ wrasslin’. Right now, you can access all those programs with a Peacock Premium subscription. Save up to 50% on your first 12 months with the latest Peacock promo codes for Black Friday and subscription deals.
With over 30 million subscribers and a range of plans, Peacock has quickly become a popular streaming service alongside titans like Netflix and Hulu. It even beat competitors for the Olympics and exclusive Paralympics coverage last summer. With original favorites like The Office, Poker Face, and Brooklyn Nine-Nine , and popular films like Oppenheimer and Jaws (as the film hits its 50th anniversary), there’s something for everyone in the family on Peacock TV. Check out our Peacock coupons, along with other great ways to save while streaming your faves.
Save up to $80 With Today’s Peacock Promo Codes and Subscription Deals
With approximately 792 subscriptions, it can be hard to know exactly how much I’m paying for each (not to mention how much I’m spending each month) and which ones have the content I want to watch most. Peacock also knows that most people use several streaming services and that it’s important to choose the ones that fit best with your budget and needs. Coming in clutch when you're still in “stay-inside-and-keep-warm” mode, Peacock is offering one full year of Peacock streaming for only $80.
One of the best ways to save on Peacock streaming is to choose the annual plan instead of the monthly plan. The annual plan costs $80, which means you’ll get 12 months for the price of 10 and save 16% on a Premium yearly plan, for only $9 per month—otherwise it’s $11 when paid monthly. There’s also Premium Plus, which has no ads, the ability to download and watch certain titles while offline, and includes your local NBC channel live, 24/7. This subscription tier is $17 per month, or $14 when paid annually. In short, you’ll be paying only $80 annually for either Basic or Premium plans!
​​Peacock Student Discount for $6 Per Month
Being a student often means pinching pennies and eating instant ramen—we know you’re trying to save money wherever you can. With this Peacock TV student discount, eligible college students and young adults ages 18 to 24 can get a full year of Peacock Premium for just $6 a month. That’s $8 in savings per month! To claim this Peacock TV student discount, all you need to do is verify your age.
Military Members and Teachers Get $7 Off Peacock
To unlock more discounts on a Peacock subscription, check whether you qualify for their exclusive offers for students, teachers, military members, medical workers, and other first responders. If you want Peacock for the whole family, you can stream on up to 3 devices at once and create up to 6 profiles with kid-safety settings. Peacock also offers discounts for military members and teachers – verify your status to get 12 months of Peacock Premium for $4 per month.
One of the easiest ways to save on streaming services is to bundle them for a major discount. With this Apple TV and Peacock bundle , you get both services together for as little as $15 per month (essentially the price of one). You’ll save over 30% and won’t have to choose between Apple TV and Peacock. The first tier includes Apple TV and Peacock Premium, with movies, TV, Peacock originals, live sports from Peacock, and Apple originals, starting at $15 per month. The next tier, Apple TV and Peacock Premium Plus, includes all of that plus ad-free viewing and downloads, starting at $20 per month. If you already have a Peacock subscription billed directly by Peacock, you can simply sign in and upgrade to the bundle in your account.
Save up to 40% With Peacock Apple TV+ and Xfinity Bundle Deals
If it feels like you’re paying for about 403 streaming services, Peacock has reduced that number by one, at least. Now, you can bundle Xfinity and Peacock and save 40% on all your favorite media content for $15 per month. You can get Peacock, Apple TV+, and Netflix when you add StreamSaver with Xfinity Internet. Prices vary by plan: Netflix with ads is $8 per month, Peacock Premium with ads is $8 per month, and the Peacock Apple TV+ bundle is $15 per month.
There’s also the Xfinity NOW StreamSaver Bundle—for $30 per month, this Xfinity internet bundle includes NOW TV, which offers over 125 live channels and on-demand programming, Netflix with ads, Apple TV+, and Peacock Premium with ads. New or existing Xfinity Internet customers who subscribe to Gigabit or higher speed service can get two years of Peacock Premium for free, to boot! In addition to the above deals, you can get Peacock Premium at no additional cost if you’re a Diamond or Platinum tier Xfinity Rewards member with any level of Xfinity Internet. To redeem, log in to your Xfinity Rewards account, click the "Get Peacock Premium at no extra cost" reward, choose "Get This Reward", and follow the provided steps. You'll receive an email with instructions to activate your offer.
Watch Your Favorites and New Peacock TV Releases This Month
There’s a wide range of new content coming to Peacock this month, including some new releases for reality TV fans like me. Some of the newest content coming to Peacock includes horror-comedy Five Nights at Freddy's 2 , the sequel to the animatronic original nightmare. Plus, rejoice because baseball season is here, and you can catch up on the action by streaming MLB games on Peacock, including Sunday Night Baseball, MLB Sunday Leadoff, and the thrilling Postseason Wild Card Round.
If you’re like me and love to absolutely turn your brain off (I’m talking no neuron flare-ups would be detected in an MRI) and watch reality TV, let me introduce you to the wonderful world of Love Island . If you love watching Instagram models go from room to room, to the pool, to the gym, and back again in a long-form version of a game of Telephone, this is the show for you. The great part is that every episode is about an hour long, and there are approximately 4,200 episodes per season.
If you’re caught up on the latest Love Island drama, get stoked for their newest spin-off, Love Island: Beyond the Villa , where the clueless cast from the latest season tries to attempt the impossible challenge of juggling multiple social media brand endorsements. It’s a real nail-biter.
Beyond beloved reality TV shows and dramas, Peacock truly has something for everyone—especially sports fans. Tons of live games stream on the Peacock app. To watch, log in on your phone, tablet, or streaming device, then navigate to the Sports section to watch your favorite teams.
Basketball season is upon us again, and Peacock is likely the most reliable way to catch all your favorite NBA teams . Basketball fans, you’re in luck: 100 regular-season games are now available on NBC and Peacock, along with NBA playoff games, the Conference Finals, the NBA All-Star Game, and Monday games and Tuesday night doubleheaders throughout the regular season. Note that the basic "Select" subscription tier doesn't include live sports, but Plus and Premium do. Be sure to check the NBA schedule on Peacock and NBC for the full lineup.
If I’m being honest, one of the biggest reasons I have Peacock is its NFL coverage , including Sunday Night Football and playoff games. (Yes, I love Love Island and football; I contain multitudes.) After living across the country, I like to regularly watch the Chiefs, Bills, Niners, Raiders, Lions, and Chargers to keep up with the fandoms I’ve become part of. Trying to find where to watch Sunday Night Football was a headache, but now I can have the big game in my living room. (Now I’m just wondering when technology will catch up and bring Jalen Hurts into my living room as well.) Sports fans rejoice because Peacock often gets exclusive streaming rights to specific games. For example, last NFL season, Peacock was the place to stream the Week 1 game.
Like other streaming services, Peacock offers plans for every type of binge-watcher. Their subscription tiers let you customize based on what you’ll actually watch and your budget: Select, for $8 per month; Premium, for $11 per month, which includes Peacock’s catalog, live sports, current NBC and Bravo shows, and over 50 channels. Premium Plus is $17 per month or $170 per year and includes: no ads, the ability to download titles to watch offline, and access to your local NBC channel live 24/7. Peacock Premium includes over 80k hours of streaming, with new and old shows, films, and originals, live sports, currently running NBC and Bravo shows (OG Real Housewives fans know), and over 50 channels that are always streaming something. The Premium Plus plan includes everything I just mentioned, plus no ads (a huge W for people who chronically get on their phones during commercials and forget to pay attention when the show comes back on). Check out the full details on the different Peacock plans to figure out which is right for you.
Not sure what gift to get for your next celebration? A Peacock gift card gives your loved one over 80,000 hours of TV, movies, and sports. You can get a digital gift card right on Peacock’s website and send it to a recipient via email or text, with no cumbersome shipping required. With a Peacock gift card , you can pay for a Peacock streaming plan using the “Redeem Gift Card” button on the checkout page. If you’ve already made a Peacock account, you can add the gift card on your Account page. Once you’ve added the Peacock gift card to your account, you’ll be able to see the credit balance, and it will be applied to your subscription until it runs out.
